name: xmake-analyzer
description: Language server for xmake build scripts: scope-aware completion, diagnostics, hover, go to definition, references, rename, inlay hints and formatting.

enumDescriptions: `xmake format`: formats the sources of the targets with clang-format.
`xmake check clang.tidy`: checks the sources of the targets with clang-tidy.

commands.title: Reload the API Lists of xmake
Clear the Cache of the xmake APIs

xmake-analyzer.server.path.description: Path of the `xmake_analyzer` executable. Empty uses the bundled server.

xmake-analyzer.xmakePath.description: The xmake executable, asked for its version, Lua runtime and API lists.

enumDescriptions: Generate compile_commands.json when an xmake.lua or a file it includes is saved.
xmake-analyzer.compileCommands.auto.markdownDescription: When to run `xmake project -k compile_commands`, for C/C++ language servers (clangd, ...).

xmake-analyzer.compileCommands.directory.markdownDescription: Where `compile_commands.json` goes, relative to the project directory (the highest directory with an `xmake.lua`). `${workspaceFolder}` is replaced; `.` is the project directory itself. clangd finds it in `build` (and `.`) by itself.

xmake-analyzer.compileCommands.configure.markdownDescription: With the clangd extension and `compileCommands.lsp` set to `clangd`: add `--compile-commands-dir` to the workspace `clangd.arguments` and restart clangd, so that the headers of the packages, outside the project, are parsed with the commands of the project too. A `--compile-commands-dir` of your own is kept.

xmake-analyzer.compileCommands.lsp.markdownDescription: The language server the commands are made for (`--lsp` of `xmake project`); empty for none.

xmake-analyzer.queryXmake.markdownDescription: Read the API lists from the installed xmake (cached per xmake build). When disabled, or when xmake is not found, the lists bundled with the server are used.

markdownEnumDescriptions: The runtime of the installed xmake: Lua 5.4, or LuaJIT for xmake built with it.
xmake-analyzer.luaVersion.description: The Lua version scripts are checked against: syntax of newer versions is reported.

xmake-analyzer.diagnostics.enable.description: Report syntax errors and misuses of the xmake API.

xmake-analyzer.claimIncludedFiles.markdownDescription: Keep Lua language servers away from the `.lua` files loaded by `includes()`: they are added to `files.associations` (as `xmake`) and, with the Lua extension (sumneko), to `Lua.workspace.ignoreDir`, in the settings of the workspace folder. Only the entries added by this extension are updated.

xmake-analyzer.codeLens.runTask.markdownDescription: Show `▶ Run xmake <name>` above the tasks with a `set_menu`, running them in a terminal.

xmake-analyzer.format.indentScopes.markdownDescription: Indent the contents of `target(...)`, `option(...)`, ... up to their `*_end()`, as in the xmake manual. The indentation unit comes from the editor and `.editorconfig`.

xmake-analyzer.format.maxBlankLines.description: The longest run of blank lines kept by the formatter.

xmake-analyzer.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

xmake-analyzer.lints.markdownDescription: Levels of the lints by name, e.g. `{"unused-local": "allow"}`. `xmake_analyzer lint --list` lists them.

scripts.release: npm run compile && npm run build:server && node ./tasks.cjs build
scripts.debug: npm run compile:debug && cargo build && node ./tasks.cjs build --profile debug
